text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Teio Sho.
The chatter about 
Shinko Windy heard throughout the venue
is 
a mixed bag.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there was no doubt she was 
beginning to draw attention.
Determined to 
make the world realize her greatness 
today, Shinko Windy took on the race.
